pr_title: repart: Add Minimize= support for verity hash partitions

issue_context.title: Support minimizing a verity hash partition
issue_context.body:
### Component

systemd-repart

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

When setting up a new partition table and getting `systemd-repart` to calculate the contents of the verity hash partition the size currently defaults to 10MB. If the size needs to be bigger then the end user must guess an appropriate minimum size. The user cannot have the hash partition shrunk either if the minimum specified size is bigger than strictly required.

data partition configuration
```ini
[Partition]
Type           = root
Label          = rescue-usb
Format         = squashfs

Minimize       = best
CopyFiles      = /

VerityMatchKey = os
Verity         = data
```

hash partition configuration
```ini
[Partition]
Type           = root-verity
Label          = rescue-usb-hash

# Hash the data partition and populate with the hash contents
VerityMatchKey = os
Verity         = hash

# Required because the minimum size is too small
SizeMinBytes   = 150M
```

This wouldn't make sense for an A/B partition layout, but it makes perfect sense for a rescue image or similar with only a single OS+hash combination.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Either support the `Minimize=` flag or calculate the required size.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### The systemd version you checked that didn't have the feature you are asking for
